title: Horizontal coefficient compatibility of native direct evaluation
statement:
Let $l$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_l$ a finite field extension [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and put $A_k=\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak m_E^{k+1}$ with its specified quotient maps [def-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-data]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $g:Z\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes and $P_g$ the separately right-derived native direct image on coefficient sequence-site modules [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Write $e_k^W$ for evaluation and $\tau^W_{m,n}:e_m^W\to\operatorname{Res}_q e_n^W$ for the actual horizontal transition for $n\le m$, $q:A_m\to A_n$ [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition]. Define $\epsilon^g_k:P_g\mathbin{;}e_k^Y\cong e_k^Z\mathbin{;}Rg_*^{A_k}$ to be native evalP followed by the right-derived compactSupportDirectModel comparison of [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. Let $\chi^g_q:Rg_*^{A_m}\operatorname{Res}_q\cong\operatorname{Res}_qRg_*^{A_n}$ be the K-injective-normalized sfDerivedImageRestriction [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars, lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. For every object $M$ of the ordinary unbounded derived coefficient-system category on $Z$, one has
$$\tau^Y_{m,n,P_gM}\,;\,\operatorname{Res}_q(\epsilon^g_{n,M})=\epsilon^g_{m,M}\,;\,Rg_*^{A_m}(\tau^Z_{m,n,M})\,;\,\chi^g_{q,e_n^ZM},$$
where semicolon means composition in the written order. No open extension, compactification, properness, boundedness, cartesian-system condition, flatness, or preservation of K-injectives by restriction or evaluation is assumed. This includes $m=n$ and $n=0$.

proof.text: Form the ordinary direct evaluation by composing moduleEvalP with compactSupportDirectModel. Its maps on section carriers are identities. The horizontal coefficient transformations are the actual section restrictions, and proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison is identity on sections. These three section formulas give the ordinary transition square, including equal levels and arbitrary systems.

Use the generic native direct-evaluation unit equation, obtained from the localized adjunction mate and moduleEvalG unit normalization. Postcompose it with the direct-model comparison using naturality of right-derived units. This proves unit normalization of the specified compactSupportNativeDirectEvaluation in the actual coefficient categories.

Compare the chosen sfDerivedImageRestriction with the unit-normalized direct-image coefficient comparison. On a K-injective B-complex choose a K-injective replacement of its restriction to A. The two resolution equations agree; cancel the ordinary direct-image quasi-isomorphism and the localization isomorphisms. Naturality transports the equality to every derived object, so the inverse of sfDerivedImageRestriction obeys the coefficient-square unit equation on every complex. No preservation of K-injectives by restriction or evaluation is used.

Apply normalized transition naturality to the ordinary transition square of step 1, the two native evaluation comparisons normalized in step 2, and the scalar comparison normalized in step 3. The factorizations of compactSupportCoefficientTransition are precisely those of localization of the ordinary horizontal maps. The resulting square has sfDerivedImageRestriction inverse at its end; cancel this isomorphism to obtain the asserted equation.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportNativeDirectTransition
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (M : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E Z) :
    (compactSupportCoefficientTransition l E Y h).app
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.P (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) g).obj M) ≫
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y
        (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((compactSupportNativeDirectEvaluation l E g n).hom.app M) =
    (compactSupportNativeDirectEvaluation l E g m).hom.app M ≫
      (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (m + 1))).map
          ((compactSupportCoefficientTransition l E Z h).app M) ≫
      (sfDerivedImageRestriction g (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).hom.app
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Z n).obj M)
